paper.title: Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization
paper.tldr: This work introduces two visual focusing loss functions designed to establish correspondence between the model's attention and specific regions within images, leading to the emergence of spatial attention head specialization, characterized by diverse and spatially focused perceptual capabilities without requiring annotations.

paper.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
paper.tldr: Vision Transformer (ViT) attains excellent results compared to state-of-the-art convolutional networks while requiring substantially fewer computational resources to train.

paper.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
paper.tldr: It is demonstrated that the simple pre-training task of predicting which caption goes with which image is an efficient and scalable way to learn SOTA image representations from scratch on a dataset of 400 million (image, text) pairs collected from the internet.

paper.title: Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context
paper.tldr: A new dataset with the goal of advancing the state-of-the-art in object recognition by placing the question of object recognition in the context of the broader question of scene understanding by gathering images of complex everyday scenes containing common objects in their natural context.
